production.note: US model years 2024 onward: Edmunds lists a '2024 Tesla Model 3 Performance'; InsideEVs covers the launch of the '2024 Tesla Model 3 Performance' (insideevs-model-3-performance-2024); Electrek (Fred Lambert, 1 Oct 2026) reports the US car still on sale with a revised rating (electrek-model-3-2026-update). The 2018-2023 Model 3 Performance is a different car (tesla-model-3-performance-pre-highland).

configuration.note: Edmunds: 'Electric'. Two motors, one per axle.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (database and articles quoting Tesla). Quote (Edmunds 2024 Model 3 Performance): "Horsepower | 510 hp". InsideEVs: "Tesla says that this car has an astounding 510 horsepower, which bests the outgoing model's 455 HP" (insideevs-model-3-performance-2024). SoyaCincau quotes the US Tesla website: "510hp of peak power and a 0-60mph time of 2.9 seconds, up to a top speed of 163mph" (soyacincau-model-3-performance-2024); Chinese-built cars for other markets are rated 460 hp. Electrek (1 Oct 2026): "Tesla listed the car at 510 hp when it launched in 2024" and peak power is now "'improved' at 528 hp" (electrek-model-3-2026-update); reference year 2024 uses the launch rating.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (databases). 2024 Model 3 Performance (one configuration). Quote (Edmunds): "Curb weight | 4,054 lbs." KBB 2024 Model 3 specs, Performance Sedan 4D column: "Curb Weight | ... | 4054 pounds" (kbb-model-3-2024). The two agree.

discrepancies.reason: Date. Tesla listed 510 hp at the 2024 launch; Electrek reports that from October 2026 Tesla lists 528 hp for the US car.
discrepancies.resolution: Reference year 2024, so the launch rating of 510 hp is used.

provisionalNote: Power (510 hp) rests on Edmunds (database) and on InsideEVs and SoyaCincau reporting Tesla's US website; weight (4,054 lb) rests on Edmunds and KBB (databases), which agree. Tesla's own specification page (tesla.com, unreadable here) or a major magazine's specification panel for the 2024 Model 3 Performance would replace both. Tesla raised the listed rating to 528 hp in October 2026.
